commit: READY_TO_COMMIT -> COMMITTED only after completeness() == [] ; then :endteach / :endexample (the trace becomes learning evidence)
abort: any state -> ABORTED: sandbox restored to the demonstration's start snapshot, S.teach cleared, zero evidence; reasons: NO_STEPS, EXAMPLE_INCOMPLETE, SLOT_RECOVERY_FAIL, MISSING_SLOT, INCOMPLETE, PREMATURE_TERMINATION, RESTARTED_BY_TEACHER, TEACHER_GAVE_NO_REMAINING_STEPS, EPISODE_END
execution_model: slots execute one by one inside the teaching sandbox (later slots need earlier runtime results for grounding); the demonstration as a whole is one transaction over the sandbox snapshot: commit = evidence admission, abort = rollback of every slot
